answer: Notarize every identity on a marble slab that is appended, never edited, and republished each epoch. Watchdogs track the nadir of each account, the lowest verified activity across a rolling window, and flag any head whose claims stay high while its nadir sits at zero. Reputation then reads like cedar rings: depth must be layered, one ring per epoch, so a burst inside a single round leaves no rings and earns nothing. Passing needs a nadir above zero across many consecutive rings, which a fleet can fake only by paying full cost per identity.
